US Senate Republicans Release Revised Crypto Bill

U.S. Senate Republicans have released a revised draft of a major cryptocurrency bill, aiming to address concerns from Democrats regarding ethics provisions and from the banking industry about potential impacts on lending. The updated text was made public ahead of a critical vote scheduled for Tuesday. The bill's proponents stated that the revisions were made to accommodate these specific concerns.
